declared_source_refs: Tianxia_Sphere_Compendium_Player_Facing_Compilation_HF05L_HF05G_EDITORIAL_CLEANUP_2026_06_26(1).md :: Sphere of Berserker :: Core Berserker Rules > Adrenaline

exact_name_nonheading_hits.text: Berserker remains the specialist sphere for committed fury, Adrenaline, Batter, and exertion risk. Axes can be fierce but is not rage by default.
Core Chassis: Adrenaline, Batter, Battered state, Exertion talents
Berserker cultivates committed force. Its basic loop is to accept risk through Adrenaline, land a Batter attack, and exploit the target’s physically disrupted Battered state with one Exertion talent.
At the start of your turn, choose whether to enter Adrenaline until the start of your next turn.
While Adrenaline is active:
gain the benefit of one Adrenaline talent you know.
You may choose a different Adrenaline talent each time you activate Adrenaline.
Unless a talent says otherwise, activate only one Adrenaline talent at a time.
When you learn Berserker, gain Adrenaline and choose one Mortal Realm Adrenaline talent for which you meet the prerequisites.
An Adrenaline talent modifies the benefit gained while accepting the Adrenaline AC penalty.

exact_name_nonheading_hits.text: The Sphere of Dreams cultivates symbols, sleep, subconscious pressure, and lucid passage. Its practitioners plant Dream Seeds, create Dreamscapes, soothe allies, frighten enemies, and walk roads that exist only while the waking world loosens its grip.
A Dream Seed is a symbolic impression planted in one creature’s subconscious.
A Dream Seed is not a visible mark.
a Dream Seed on an awake unwilling creature lasts until the start of your next turn;
a Dream Seed on a willing or sleeping creature lasts for 1 hour;
a creature may bear only one of your Dream Seeds at a time;
a Dream Seed allows you to use Seed talents on that creature;
a Dream Seed ends if a talent consumes it. A sleeping creature does not automatically wake when a Dream Seed is planted.
Apply Dream Seed automatically.
The Dream Seed lasts for 1 hour.

exact_name_nonheading_hits.text: Qi Cultivation. A Qi Cultivator expresses Beauty through refined aura, fragrance, color, light, movement, cultivated clothing, flower wind, artful qi shaping, talismanic presentation, or elegant pressure. Qi Cultivators may project Beauty outward normally through legal sphere effects.
You may use presentation, costume, ritual posture, music, fragrance, calligraphy, rank tokens, banners, or ceremonial arrangement as supporting components for a noncombat project.

Flowers / Verdant Growth. Flowers and Verdant Growth provide pollen, spores, fragrances, medicinal blooms, plant life, and parasitic blossoms. Disease defines the infection pattern. Flowers may deliver or express that pattern.
Sphere Type: Power / Nature / Fragrance / Influence Sphere
Resource: CP, Blossoms, Fragrances, pollen or scent markers, medicinal blooms, poison blooms, and Concentration when a talent says so
Core Chassis: Blossoms, Bloom timing, Fragrance effects, support/control/poison/concealment branches

Flowers cultivates growth, fragrance, medicine, pollen, and delayed bloom. Its basic loop is to plant Blossoms, choose when they bloom, and shape drifting Fragrances into support, control, poison, or concealment.
A Fragrance is a drifting spiritual pollen cloud.
a Fragrance occupies a 15-foot-radius sphere;
a Fragrance uses Concentration;

exact_name_nonheading_hits.text: Core Chassis: Weight Shift, Spatial Awareness of down/anchor pressure, Weighted Strike, External Weight Shift
When you first learn the Sphere of Gravity, you gain Weight Shift and learn one Gravity talent for which you meet the prerequisites.
You may change modes only once on each of your turns unless a talent says otherwise. If you are Incapacitated, your Weight Shift becomes Neutral Weight.
You return to normal weight. Ending Weight Shift early requires no action on your turn.
When you use Weight Shift, you may spend 1 CP or Stamina to apply the same mode to one willing creature you touch.
A creature can benefit from only one Weight Shift at a time. If multiple Weight Shifts apply, the creature chooses which one remains.
While Gravitic Armor is active, your Weight Shift modes improve:
Your Field Art range is halved unless the target is adjacent to you, touching the ground you stand on, or affected by your Weight Shift.

While Body Heavying is active, your base Weight Shift damage bonus applies to the first melee hit you land each turn even if you moved more than half your Speed, as long as you moved in a straight line toward the target.
Weight Shift costs 1 CP or Stamina if you maintain Body Lightening or Body Heavying for more than one consecutive round.

exact_name_heading_hits.heading: ##### Success Against a Mortal, Foundation, or Core Pattern
##### Success Against a Nascent Soul Pattern or Domain
##### Success Against a Secret Inheritance, artifact, Formation project, or campaign-scale working

#### Object, Barrier, or Effect Make one Cultivation Check against a GM-set DC. On a success, choose one: - pierce one major breach; - destroy one temporary Barrier; - suppress one ordinary ongoing effect; - disable one Formation Anchor until repaired; - pin one movable object in place until the end of your next turn. The Point That Pinned Heaven to Earth does not automatically destroy: - artifacts; - Formation cores; - Domains; - Secret Inheritances; - Realm-defining structures; - permanent karmic bonds. Those may still be contested or meaningfully damaged according to the GM.

exact_name_nonheading_hits.text: Successful Save: Push the target 5 feet.
Successful Save: Pull the target 5 feet.
Success: Reduce the attack’s damage by 1d8 + your Proficiency Bonus.
Success by 5 or more: The attack misses instead.

Clear disperses nonmagical smoke, harmless gas, dust, pollen, light fog, incense, or similar airborne material in the Current. If the material is magical or generated by a cultivation effect, make an Air Check against the effect’s save DC. On a success, suppress that material in the Current until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: Until the start of your next turn, the target has Disadvantage on the next check requiring speech, breath control, song, chant, roar, or verbal command.
Successful Save: Push the target 10 feet.
Successful Save: It is not lifted, but the Updraft’s space is Difficult Terrain for it.
Successful Save: It takes half damage and does not fall Prone.
Successful Save: It takes no additional damage.

exact_name_nonheading_hits.text: Shield remains the specialist sphere for active defense, carried cover, catching, and redirection through a shield face. Axes can break or hook shields, but does not become a defense sphere.
This does not grant Shield sphere talents, shield active defense, shield attacks, or shield deflection techniques.
**Shield.** Shield owns active defense. Equipment can grant shield proficiency, but it does not grant Shield sphere techniques.
The Sphere of Protection teaches active defense. Its practitioners place Aegises on creatures, sacrifice prepared defenses through Succor, and create Wards that shelter an area.
Protection creates active defenses. Permanent fortifications and prepared infrastructure belong to Formation projects.

Common Effects: Active Defense, shield angles, Deflect talents, carried cover, redirection, shield bashes, shield skating, projected Shield Faces, moving ramparts, Shield Intent, Shield Soul, calamity turning
Active Defense applies to attack rolls unless a talent explicitly expands it to another kind of effect.
You may use Active Defense after the attack roll is made but before damage or another hit effect resolves.
You may expend Martial Focus to use Active Defense without spending a Reaction.
Active Defense applies only against the triggering attack;

exact_name_nonheading_hits.text: Mortal Realm: Deadly Aim, Snipe Shot, long-range discipline, ricochets, pinning, disarming, piercing, pushing, intercepting ranged attacks, disabling traps at range, and careful repositioning.
Deadly Aim improves a ranged attack that already has Advantage. If Advantage and Disadvantage cancel, the attack does not have Advantage and Deadly Aim does not apply.
Deadly Aim does not stack with other benefits that allow an additional die selection or repeated reroll from Advantage.
You gain Deadly Aim.
Deadly Aim applies;
Once per short or long rest, when the trigger occurs and your Readied Snipe Shot hits, you may apply Deadly Aim even if the attack did not have Advantage.
When using Trap Technician, you may target a trap component behind Half Cover without penalty, and you may use Deadly Aim on the attack if you have Advantage from careful study or scouting.

exact_name_nonheading_hits.text: Mortal Realm: Deadly Aim, Snipe Shot, long-range discipline, ricochets, pinning, disarming, piercing, pushing, intercepting ranged attacks, disabling traps at range, and careful repositioning.
Unless a talent says otherwise, Snipe Shot applies only to a ranged weapon attack made with a ranged or thrown weapon.
When you take the Attack action, you may replace one attack with a Snipe Shot.
a Snipe Shot is still one attack;
a Snipe Shot can benefit from Advantage or suffer Disadvantage normally;
only one Snipe talent applies to a Snipe Shot;
a missed Snipe Shot usually has no Snipe effect;
a Snipe Shot consumes ammunition or the thrown weapon normally;
a Snipe Shot cannot be used with an area effect unless a talent says so;
A Snipe talent changes one Snipe Shot.

exact_name_heading_hits.heading: ### Wrap the Head, Return the Edge - Parry

exact_name_nonheading_hits.text: Trigger: A creature you can see within 60 feet uses a reaction, counter, parry, interception, opportunity attack, or comparable immediate defensive technique
Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, Parry and Riposte, CL 5+
You may use Parry and Riposte when a ranged weapon attack or ranged spell attack hits you.
Parry Anything does not reduce damage from an effect that does not hit you with an attack roll.
Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, Parry and Riposte, CL 5+
When Parry and Riposte reduces the triggering attack’s damage to 0, regain Martial Focus after resolving the retaliatory attack.
when you win a Disarm attempt or reduce an attack’s damage to 0 with Parry and Riposte, regain Martial Focus.
Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, Parry and Riposte, CL 15+
- you may spend Stamina instead of CP for Sabers talents that are melee, self, held-weapon, movement, or parry effects, if your table allows Body Refiner sphere expenditure through Stamina;
Parry talents answer attacks with countercuts.

exact_name_nonheading_hits.text: Core Chassis: Feints, precision attacks, tactical openings, footwork, disarming, binds, parries, ripostes, meridian-point strikes
Common Effects: Feints, precision attacks, tactical openings, footwork, disarming, weapon binds, parries, ripostes, draw cuts, and meridian-point strikes
- Piercing Needle talents create openings through measure, feints, exact strikes, binds, parries, ripostes, and meridian-point pressure.
A Guard talent improves parries, ripostes, disarming, or weapon binds.
Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, Parry and Riposte, CL 5+
You may use Parry and Riposte when a ranged weapon attack or ranged spell attack hits you.

exact_name_heading_hits.heading: #### Body Refining - Iron-Rain Body Use Strength or Dexterity for Barrage saving throw DCs, choosing when learning the sphere.
##### Hostile Creatures When one hostile creature starts its turn inside and is adjacent to one Beast Ally, it makes a Wisdom saving throw.
##### Crimson Aura When a Bloodied enemy starts its turn within 20 feet, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
##### Enemies A hostile creature entering for the first time on a turn or starting its turn inside makes a Wisdom saving throw.
##### Enemies When an enemy starts its turn inside, it makes a Wisdom saving throw.

#### Hold the Line - gain +1 AC against creatures inside your Spear Line; - gain Advantage on checks and saving throws against forced movement; - when a creature bearing your Spear Intent enters your Spear Line, it treats that movement as difficult terrain.

#### You and Allies - gain +1 AC against creatures bearing your Spear Intent; - move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks after hitting with a Spear attack, once per turn; - gain Advantage on checks and saving throws against forced movement.
#### Enemies When an enemy enters for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside, it makes a Wisdom saving throw.
#### Allies - gain Half Cover; - gain Advantage on checks and saving throws against forced movement; - move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks after hitting, once per turn.
#### Enemies When one enters for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside, it makes a Dexterity saving throw.

exact_name_nonheading_hits.text: - Axes - axe weapons, heavy hewing, hook control, guard breaking, thrown axe openings, and execution pressure.
- Wrestling - grappling, holds, throws, pins, bodily domination.
- Barrage - thrown weapons, rapid strikes, projectile body training.
| Cultivation Save DC | default sphere/talent saving throw DC; 8 + Proficiency Bonus + relevant key ability modifier unless a printed formula overrides | `save_dc` |
- **Sphere of Axes** — martial hewing, Bite, Hook, guard-breaking, thrown axe disruption, poleaxe leverage, and execution authority.

Ranged Attacks: Ranged weapon and spell attacks follow ordinary attack roll rules unless a talent changes them. Air talents that interfere with arrows, thrown weapons, or projectile lines define their own trigger and effect.

Objects and Projectiles: Arrows, thrown weapons, darts, needles, bolts, bullets, and similar projectiles can be affected by Air talents. Siege ammunition, falling boulders, massive weapons, or supernatural attacks require explicit permission.
Storming Current: enough to threaten multiple creatures, impose saving throws, create storm terrain, or contest flight.
When an Air talent calls for a saving throw, use your Cultivation Save DC.
When an Air talent affects a projectile, it can affect ordinary ranged weapon attacks and thrown weapon attacks unless stated otherwise.
